observations.signal: Declared Foundation-domain syntax remains outside the canonical Native RBC/VM subset even though its JavaScript reference semantics and provider bridges are mature.

Lowering every Foundation domain in one step would carry high implementation cost and regression risk; the perception Observe path already maps naturally onto existing core transaction/state/preserve/witness semantics.
Whole-language native self-host closure remains bounded by Stage-0 host ownership.

ranked_candidates.problem: create a fail-closed direct-lowering seam that rewrites declared perception Observe semantics into existing core RCL transaction semantics before RBC compilation, without provider calls
evidence: reuse existing Native RBC/VM transaction opcodes
leave unsupported Foundation declarations intact so canonical bytecode validation still fails closed

ranked_candidates.problem: lower all declared Foundation domains into native RBC in one step
remove remaining Stage-0 host ownership from whole-language self-host closure

mode_reason: After the global causal/evidence seam closed, native lowering is the dominant remaining bottleneck. Deepen one state-transition-equivalent Foundation slice first instead of claiming whole-Foundation native closure without parity evidence.
behavioral_change: Observe directives for declared perception domains can be deterministically rewritten into ordinary Emergence + Realize core semantics
channel expressions, state targets and preserve invariants remain structurally identical through the rewrite
a deterministic Foundation perception witness is attached to the synthesized core transaction
unobserved perceptions and all other Foundation domains remain declared, so the existing canonical bytecode validator continues to reject unsupported semantics rather than silently dropping them
a provider-neutral adapter can pass the transformed program into the existing bytecode compiler without changing canonical bytecode.mjs

adapter_contract.method: exact candidate adapter loaded against injected compileReality/tryCompileRealityToBytecode stubs and verified one perception lowering reaches the bytecode adapter boundary

ci_policy: Every branch commit carries [skip ci] [skip actions]. Do not actively consume GitHub Actions; verify the head remains workflow-free before PR/merge.
truth_boundary: This cycle creates the first bounded direct-lowering compiler seam for Perception Observe state transitions. It does not claim C Native VM execution parity, domain-receipt parity, all-Foundation native lowering, removal of Foundation provider bridges, or repository-wide regression coverage. Unsupported declarations remain fail-closed through the existing bytecode validator.
